recipes.name: Bacon and Egg Spaghetti with Peas
recipes.description: Spaghetti in a silky egg and parmesan sauce with crisp bacon, garlic and sweet peas.
steps: Boil the spaghetti in salted water until al dente, adding the peas for the last minute.
Meanwhile, cook the chopped bacon in a large skillet until crisp, then stir in the garlic.
Whisk the eggs with the parmesan and pepper in a bowl.
Drain the pasta, saving 1/2 cup of the pasta water, and toss it in the skillet over low heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and toss constantly for 1 to 2 minutes, loosening with pasta water, until the sauce thickens.

recipes.name: Baked Chicken Parmesan with Spaghetti
recipes.description: Crispy oven-baked breaded chicken topped with marinara and melted mozzarella over spaghetti.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and oil a sheet pan.
Halve the chicken breasts horizontally into 4 cutlets.
Dip each cutlet in the beaten egg, then coat in the breadcrumbs mixed with the parmesan, Italian seasoning and salt.
Drizzle with the remaining oil and bake 18 minutes, flipping once.
Top each cutlet with a spoonful of marinara and the mozzarella and bake 5 more minutes.
Boil the spaghetti, toss it with the remaining warmed marinara and serve with the chicken.

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli Ramen Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Ground beef, broccoli and ramen noodles tossed in a sweet garlic soy sauce.
steps: Boil the ramen noodles for 3 minutes without the seasoning packets, then drain.
Whisk the soy sauce, brown sugar, cornstarch, ground ginger and 1/2 cup water.
Brown the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes, then drain the fat.
Add the garlic and frozen broccoli, cover and cook 4 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and simmer 2 minutes until it thickens.
Toss in the noodles, sesame oil and green onions.

recipes.name: Beef Stew with Potatoes and Carrots
recipes.description: Slow-simmered beef with potatoes, carrots, celery and peas in a rich thyme and tomato gravy.
steps: Toss the beef with the flour, salt and pepper, then brown it in the oil in a large pot for 6 minutes.
Add the onion, celery and garlic and cook 4 minutes, then stir in the tomato paste.
Pour in the broth and Worcestershire, add the thyme and simmer, covered, for 1 hour.
Add the potatoes and carrots and simmer 35 to 40 minutes until everything is tender.
Stir in the peas, cook 3 minutes and serve.

recipes.name: Black Bean and Cheddar Enchiladas
recipes.description: Corn tortillas rolled around black beans, corn and cheddar, baked under red enchilada sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Roughly mash the drained beans with the corn, onion, cumin, chili powder and half the cheddar.
Warm the tortillas in the microwave under a damp towel so they bend without cracking.
Spread a little sauce in a 9x13 dish, fill and roll the tortillas and set them seam side down.
Pour the remaining sauce over the top and cover with the rest of the cheddar.
Bake 20 minutes until bubbling, then top with yogurt and cilantro.

recipes.name: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Tacos
recipes.description: Chili-roasted sweet potatoes and black beans in corn tortillas with avocado and lime.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the diced sweet potatoes with the oil, cumin, chili powder, smoked paprika and salt and roast 22 minutes, turning once.
Add the drained beans to the pan for the last 5 minutes to warm through.
Char the tortillas in a dry skillet or over a gas flame.
Fill with sweet potatoes and beans and top with red onion, avocado, feta, salsa and cilantro.
Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.name: Blackened Tilapia Chopped Salad
recipes.description: Spice-crusted tilapia seared in a hot skillet and served over a crunchy romaine, pepper and feta salad.
steps: Mix the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, thyme, cayenne, salt and pepper and coat the tilapia.
Sear the fish in 1 tablespoon of the olive oil 3 minutes per side until dark and flaky.
Chop the romaine, bell pepper and cucumber into a large bowl.
Dress the salad with the remaining olive oil and the lemon juice and add the feta.
Serve the fish on top of the salad.

recipes.name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
recipes.description: A thick, creamy broccoli soup finished with plenty of sharp cheddar.
steps: Cook the onion in the butter over medium heat for 5 minutes, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the chopped broccoli, broth, salt and pepper and simmer covered for 12 minutes until very tender.
Mash or blend about half the soup, leaving some broccoli pieces.
Stir in the cream and cream cheese over low heat until smooth.
Add the cheddar a handful at a time, stirring until melted, and serve.

recipes.name: Cajun Tilapia over Seasoned Rice
recipes.description: Spice-rubbed tilapia fillets seared in butter and served over paprika rice with fresh tomato and lemon.
steps: Simmer the rice with 3 cups water, 1 teaspoon of the paprika and half the salt, covered, 18 minutes.
Mix the remaining paprika and salt with the garlic powder, onion powder, oregano, thyme and cayenne and coat the fish.
Sear the tilapia in the butter 3 to 4 minutes per side.
Fluff the rice and top with the fish.
Serve with sliced tomato and lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Cauliflower Egg Fried Rice
recipes.description: Riced cauliflower stir-fried with scrambled eggs, mushrooms, carrot and green onion.
steps: Scramble the eggs in 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large skillet, then set them aside.
Cook the mushrooms and carrot in the remaining oil over high heat for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and frozen cauliflower rice and stir-fry 5 to 6 minutes until dry and tender.
Return the eggs to the pan with the soy sauce and sesame oil and toss.
Top with green onion.

recipes.name: Cauliflower Mac and Cheese Bake
recipes.description: Tender cauliflower florets baked in a rich cheddar cream sauce with a golden parmesan top.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and boil the cauliflower florets in salted water for 5 minutes, then drain very well.
Warm the cream and cream cheese in a saucepan over low heat, whisking until smooth.
Whisk in the mustard, garlic powder, salt, pepper and three quarters of the cheddar until melted.
Fold the cauliflower into the sauce and spread in a baking dish.
Top with the remaining cheddar, the parmesan and paprika.
Bake 15 minutes until bubbling and browned.

recipes.name: Cheesy Chicken Broccoli Bake
recipes.description: Tender chicken and broccoli in a creamy garlic sauce, baked until the cheddar on top is golden and bubbling.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and brown in a skillet 5 to 6 minutes.
Stir the cream cheese, sour cream, broth, garlic powder, onion powder, salt and pepper until smooth.
Combine the chicken, broccoli, sauce and half the cheddar in a baking dish.
Top with the remaining cheddar and bake 20 minutes until bubbling.

recipes.name: Cheesy Chicken and Broccoli Penne Bake
recipes.description: Penne, chicken and broccoli baked in a homemade cheddar sauce under a crisp breadcrumb topping.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and boil the penne 2 minutes less than the package says, adding the broccoli for the last minute, then drain.
Cook the diced chicken in half the butter in a large oven-safe skillet for 6 minutes, then set it aside.
Melt the remaining butter, stir in the garlic and flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thick.
Stir in most of the cheddar, the salt and pepper, then fold in the pasta, broccoli and chicken.
Top with the remaining cheddar and the breadcrumbs.
Bake 15 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Cheesy Tuna Cauliflower Casserole
recipes.description: Classic tuna casserole comfort with cauliflower instead of noodles, baked under a cheddar and parmesan crust.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and boil the cauliflower florets 5 minutes, then drain well.
Stir the cream cheese, sour cream, mustard, garlic powder, salt and pepper together.
Fold in the drained tuna, celery, cauliflower and 1 cup of the cheddar.
Spread in a baking dish and top with the remaining cheddar and the parmesan.
Bake 20 minutes until bubbling and golden.

recipes.name: Chicken & Black Bean Burrito Bowls
recipes.description: Taco-spiced chicken over rice with black beans, corn, peppers and salsa: a burrito you eat with a fork.
steps: Simmer the rice with 3 cups water, covered, 18 minutes.
Coat the chicken with the taco seasoning and cook in the olive oil 5 to 6 minutes per side, then slice.
Saute the bell pepper 4 minutes and warm the beans and corn.
Divide the rice among bowls and top with the chicken, beans, corn and pepper.
Finish with salsa, sour cream, jalapeno and lime.

recipes.name: Chicken Burrito Cauliflower Rice Skillet
recipes.description: Taco-seasoned chicken thighs with peppers, salsa and cauliflower rice under melted cheddar, all in one pan.
steps: Cut the chicken into small pieces and toss with the taco seasoning.
Brown the chicken in the oil 6 to 8 minutes.
Add the onion and bell pepper and cook 4 minutes.
Stir in the cauliflower rice and salsa and cook 5 minutes until tender.
Sprinkle with cheddar, cover and let it melt.
Finish with cilantro and lime wedges.

recipes.name: Chicken Cauliflower Fried Rice
recipes.description: Golden cauliflower rice stir-fried with chicken, scrambled egg and green onion, ready faster than takeout.
steps: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and season with salt and turmeric.
Stir-fry the chicken in the vegetable oil 6 to 7 minutes until cooked through, then set aside.
Scramble the eggs in the same pan and break them into small pieces.
Add the garlic, carrot and cauliflower rice and cook 5 minutes.
Return the chicken, add the soy sauce and sesame oil and toss.
Top with green onions.

recipes.name: Chicken Tortilla Soup with Black Beans
recipes.description: Brothy tomato-chili soup with shredded chicken, black beans and corn, topped with crushed tortilla chips.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and cook the onion for 4 minutes, then add the garlic, cumin and chili powder.
Add the broth, diced tomatoes and whole chicken breasts and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
Lift out the chicken, shred it with two forks and return it to the pot.
Stir in the black beans, corn and salt and simmer 5 minutes.
Finish with the lime juice and serve topped with crushed tortilla chips and cilantro.

recipes.name: Chicken and Vegetable Stir-Fry with Rice
recipes.description: Sliced chicken breast and frozen stir-fry vegetables in a garlic-ginger soy glaze over rice.
steps: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Whisk the soy sauce, honey, cornstarch and 1/4 cup water in a small bowl.
Heat half the oil in a large skillet over high heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes until browned, then set it aside.
Add the remaining oil and the frozen vegetables and stir-fry 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger, return the chicken and pour in the sauce.
Cook 2 minutes until glossy, then finish with the sesame oil and serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Chickpea Spinach Coconut Curry
recipes.description: Chickpeas and spinach in a mild coconut tomato curry, spooned over white rice.
steps: Start the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, for 18 minutes.
Cook the onion in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk, drained chickpeas and salt and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Serve the curry over the rice.

recipes.name: Classic Beef and Bean Chili
recipes.description: Thick ground beef chili with kidney and pinto beans, tomatoes and warm chili spices, topped with cheddar.
steps: Brown the ground beef with the onion and bell pepper in a large pot for 8 minutes, then drain the fat.
Stir in the garlic, chili powder, cumin, oregano and salt and cook 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, broth and drained beans.
Bring to a boil, then simmer partly covered for 40 minutes, stirring now and then.
Serve topped with the cheddar.

recipes.name: Classic Meatloaf with Mashed Potatoes
recipes.description: Ketchup-glazed beef meatloaf with buttery mashed potatoes and peas.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Mix the ground beef with the breadcrumbs, egg, 1/4 cup of the milk, onion, garlic, Worcestershire, half the ketchup and 1 teaspoon salt.
Shape into a loaf on a lined sheet pan and brush with the remaining ketchup mixed with the brown sugar.
Bake 50 minutes until the center reaches 160°F, then rest 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and mash with the butter, remaining milk, salt and pepper.
Warm the peas and serve with the sliced meatloaf and mashed potatoes.

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese Baked Penne
recipes.description: Penne baked with marinara, spinach and a creamy cottage cheese layer under melted mozzarella.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and boil the penne 2 minutes short of the package time, then drain.
Squeeze the thawed spinach dry and stir it into the cottage cheese with the egg, garlic, Italian seasoning, salt, pepper and half the mozzarella.
Toss the penne with the marinara and spread half in a 9x13 baking dish.
Spoon the cottage cheese mixture over the pasta and cover with the rest of the penne.
Top with the remaining mozzarella and the parmesan.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling and golden, then rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Creamy Lemon Garlic Chicken Skillet
recipes.description: Pan-seared chicken breasts simmered in a lemon, garlic and parmesan cream sauce, served with steamed broccoli.
steps: Season the chicken with Italian seasoning, salt and pepper.
Sear in the olive oil and butter 5 to 6 minutes per side, then set aside.
Cook the garlic 30 seconds, then add the broth, cream and juice of half the lemon.
Simmer 4 minutes, stir in the parmesan and return the chicken with the remaining lemon, sliced.
Steam the broccoli and serve it alongside with the sauce spooned over.

recipes.name: Creamy Tomato Tortellini Soup
recipes.description: Cheese tortellini and spinach in a creamy tomato broth, ready in one pot.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes, then add the garlic and Italian seasoning for 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes and broth and bring to a simmer.
Add the tortellini and cook 5 to 7 minutes until tender.
Stir in the cream and spinach until the spinach wilts.
Serve with parmesan.

recipes.name: Curried Lentil Dal with Rice
recipes.description: Lentils simmered soft with tomatoes, ginger and curry spices, served over rice with cool yogurt.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil over medium heat for 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic, ginger, curry powder, cumin and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes, broth, 3 cups of water and the salt.
Simmer partly covered for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils are soft and thick.
Meanwhile cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, for 18 minutes.
Mash some of the lentils against the pot to thicken the dal.
Serve over rice with a spoonful of yogurt and chopped cilantro.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Shrimp & Mushroom Skillet
recipes.description: Shrimp, mushrooms and zucchini sauteed in garlic butter with lemon and a pinch of red pepper.
steps: Saute the mushrooms and zucchini in the olive oil 5 to 6 minutes until browned.
Push the vegetables aside and melt the butter with the garlic and pepper flakes.
Add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side until pink.
Toss everything with the lemon juice and salt.

recipes.name: Garlic Herb Drumsticks with Green Beans
recipes.description: Crispy oven-roasted drumsticks rubbed with garlic, paprika and herbs, with buttery lemon green beans.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the drumsticks with the olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper.
Roast on a sheet pan 35 to 40 minutes, turning once, until crisp and cooked through.
Simmer the green beans 5 minutes, drain, then toss with the butter, garlic and lemon juice.
Serve the drumsticks with the green beans.

recipes.name: Ginger Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Seared sirloin with broccoli, green beans and bell pepper in a garlic, ginger and soy sauce; no rice required.
steps: Cut the steak into bite-size pieces and toss with 1 tablespoon of the soy sauce.
Sear the beef in the vegetable oil over high heat 2 to 3 minutes, then set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli, green beans and bell pepper with a splash of water 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook 30 seconds.
Return the beef with the remaining soy sauce and the sesame oil and toss.

recipes.name: Greek Chickpea Salad with Warm Pita
recipes.description: Chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes and feta in a lemon oregano dressing over romaine with warm pita.
steps: Whisk the oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the drained chickpeas, cucumber, halved tomatoes and red onion and toss.
Fold in the feta.
Warm the pitas in a dry skillet or toaster and cut into wedges.
Serve the salad over chopped romaine with the pita.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Alfredo Penne with Peas
recipes.description: Penne and peas in a creamy garlic parmesan sauce made with Greek yogurt instead of cream.
steps: Boil the penne until al dente, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Save a cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Melt the butter in the empty pot over low heat and cook the garlic for 1 minute.
Take the pot off the heat and whisk in the yogurt, milk, parmesan, salt and pepper.
Add the pasta and peas and toss, loosening with pasta water until the sauce coats the penne.

recipes.name: Ground Beef Tacos with Lime Cabbage Slaw
recipes.description: Seasoned ground beef in warm corn tortillas, topped with a crunchy lime cabbage slaw, cheddar and salsa.
steps: Brown the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes, then drain the fat.
Stir in the taco seasoning and 1/2 cup water and simmer 3 minutes.
Toss the shredded cabbage with the lime juice, chopped cilantro and salt.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet, about 20 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with beef, slaw, cheddar and salsa.

recipes.name: Ground Turkey Teriyaki Rice Bowls
recipes.description: Ground turkey, broccoli and carrots in a homemade honey-soy teriyaki sauce over rice.
steps: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Whisk the soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, cornstarch, ground ginger and 1/3 cup water.
Heat the oil in a large skillet and brown the turkey for 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the garlic, carrots and broccoli, cover and cook 5 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and simmer 2 minutes until thick and glossy.
Spoon over the rice and top with green onions.

recipes.name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.description: Chicken thighs simmered with carrots, celery and onion in broth, finished with egg noodles and parsley.
steps: Melt the butter in a large pot and cook the onion, carrots and celery for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, thyme, broth and chicken thighs and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
Lift out the chicken, shred it with two forks and return it to the pot.
Add the egg noodles and cook 6 to 8 minutes until tender.
Season with the salt and pepper and stir in the parsley.

recipes.name: Honey Garlic Chicken Thighs with Rice
recipes.description: Seared chicken thighs glazed in honey, garlic and soy sauce, served with rice and steamed broccoli.
steps: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Season the chicken with the salt and pepper and sear in the oil over medium-high heat for 5 to 6 minutes per side.
Stir together the honey, soy sauce, vinegar and garlic and pour it over the chicken.
Simmer 3 to 4 minutes, turning the chicken, until the glaze is sticky.
Steam or microwave the broccoli until tender.
Serve the chicken over the rice with the broccoli and spoon over the extra glaze.

recipes.name: Honey Garlic Salmon with Rice & Broccoli
recipes.description: Pan-seared salmon glazed with honey, garlic and soy, served with fluffy white rice and steamed broccoli.
steps: Simmer the rice with 3 cups water, covered, 18 minutes.
Sear the salmon in the oil 4 minutes per side.
Add the honey, soy sauce and garlic to the pan and spoon over the fish 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Steam the broccoli florets 4 to 5 minutes.
Serve the salmon with the rice and broccoli and drizzle with the glaze.

recipes.name: Italian Sausage and Pepper Penne
recipes.description: Penne with browned Italian sausage, sweet bell peppers and onion in a garlicky tomato sauce.
steps: Boil the penne in salted water until al dente, then drain, saving 1/2 cup of the pasta water.
Heat the oil in a large skillet and brown the sausage for 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the peppers and onion and cook 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the garlic, Italian seasoning and diced tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes.
Toss in the penne with a splash of pasta water and top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Italian Sausage, Zucchini & Pepper Skillet
recipes.description: Browned Italian sausage with zucchini, bell peppers and onion in one skillet; it reheats well for lunches.
steps: Slice the sausage into thick coins and brown in the olive oil 6 to 8 minutes.
Add the onion and bell peppers and cook 5 minutes.
Add the zucchini, garlic, Italian seasoning and pepper flakes.
Cook 6 to 8 minutes until the vegetables are tender and the sausage is cooked through.
Sprinkle with parmesan.

recipes.name: Lemon Chicken Thigh & Potato Bake
recipes.description: Chicken thighs roasted in one dish with potatoes, cherry tomatoes, garlic, oregano and lemon slices.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the potato chunks, tomatoes and garlic with half the olive oil, half the oregano and half the salt in a baking dish.
Rub the chicken with the remaining oil, oregano and salt and nestle it on top.
Add the lemon slices and roast 35 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are tender.
Scatter with chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Tuna Pasta
recipes.description: Pantry pasta with canned tuna, peas, garlic, lemon and parmesan that comes together while the water boils.
steps: Boil the pasta until tender, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes, and save a splash of the water.
Warm the olive oil with the garlic and pepper flakes in the empty pot 1 minute.
Add the drained tuna, pasta, peas, lemon juice and pasta water and toss.
Stir in the parmesan, salt and green onions.

recipes.name: Lentil Bolognese with Spaghetti
recipes.description: A thick tomato and lentil ragu with carrot and celery, tossed with spaghetti and parmesan.
steps: Cook the onion, carrot and celery in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, tomato paste and Italian seasoning for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, crushed tomatoes, broth, salt and pepper and simmer covered for 30 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Boil the spaghetti until al dente and drain, saving a cup of the water.
Toss the spaghetti with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.
Serve with parmesan.

recipes.name: Lettuce-Wrap Cheeseburgers
recipes.description: Juicy skillet cheeseburgers wrapped in crisp lettuce with tomato, onion and a quick burger sauce.
steps: Mix the beef with the garlic powder, salt and pepper and shape into 4 patties.
Cook the patties in a hot skillet 4 minutes per side.
Top each patty with a cheese slice and cover 1 minute to melt.
Stir the mayo and mustard together for the sauce.
Wrap each burger in large lettuce leaves with tomato, onion and sauce.

recipes.name: Mushroom Stroganoff with Egg Noodles
recipes.description: Browned mushrooms in a creamy sour cream sauce over buttered egg noodles.
steps: Boil the egg noodles until tender and drain.
Brown the mushrooms in the butter over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, then add the onion and cook 4 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, paprika and thyme for 1 minute, then the flour.
Add the broth, soy sauce and mustard and simmer 5 minutes until thickened.
Take off the heat and stir in the sour cream, salt and pepper.
Serve over the noodles with parsley.

recipes.name: One-Pan Chicken Thighs and Rice with Peas
recipes.description: Paprika chicken thighs cooked on top of garlicky rice in one pan, finished with sweet peas.
steps: Season the chicken with the paprika, thyme, salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large deep skillet and sear the chicken 3 minutes per side, then set it aside.
Melt the butter in the same pan and cook the onion 4 minutes, then stir in the garlic and rice.
Pour in the broth, bring to a boil and nestle the chicken on top.
Cover and simmer on low for 18 to 20 minutes until the rice is tender.
Scatter over the peas, cover 3 minutes and serve.

recipes.name: One-Pot Beef & Penne Skillet
recipes.description: Penne cooked right in a ground beef and tomato sauce, then finished with melted mozzarella and parmesan.
steps: Brown the beef with the onion in a deep skillet, then stir in the garlic and Italian seasoning.
Add the crushed tomatoes, broth, salt and dry penne.
Cover and simmer 12 to 14 minutes, stirring twice, until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the mozzarella and top with the parmesan.

recipes.name: One-Pot Turkey Taco Rice
recipes.description: Ground turkey, rice, black beans and corn simmered in salsa and taco seasoning, finished with melted cheddar.
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion in a large deep skillet for 6 minutes.
Stir in the taco seasoning, rice, salsa, broth, black beans and corn.
Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low for 18 minutes until the rice is tender.
Sprinkle with the cheddar, cover 2 minutes to melt and serve.

recipes.name: Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Buttered Cabbage
recipes.description: Paprika-rubbed pork chops seared until golden and served over cabbage wilted in butter, garlic and a splash of vinegar.
steps: Rub the chops with the smoked paprika, garlic powder, thyme, salt and pepper.
Sear in the olive oil 4 to 5 minutes per side, then rest on a plate.
Melt the butter in the same pan and cook the onion 2 minutes.
Add the cabbage and garlic and cook 6 to 8 minutes until tender, then stir in the vinegar.
Serve the chops over the cabbage.

recipes.name: Parmesan-Crusted Cod with Green Beans
recipes.description: Cod fillets baked under a golden parmesan crust next to garlicky roasted green beans.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the green beans with the olive oil, half the garlic powder and half the salt on a sheet pan and roast 8 minutes.
Spread the mayo over the cod and press on the parmesan mixed with the paprika and remaining garlic powder.
Add the cod to the pan and bake 12 minutes until golden and flaky.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Peanut Noodles with Cabbage and Carrots
recipes.description: Spaghetti tossed with crunchy cabbage and carrots in a creamy peanut, soy and lime sauce.
steps: Boil the spaghetti until tender, adding the coleslaw mix for the last minute, then drain.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, honey, sesame oil, sriracha, garlic, ginger and 1/3 cup hot water until smooth.
Toss the noodles and cabbage with the sauce.
Top with green onion and chopped peanuts and serve with lime wedges.

recipes.name: Peanut Tofu and Broccoli Rice Bowls
recipes.description: Crisp pan-fried tofu and broccoli over rice with a quick peanut-soy sauce.
steps: Cook the rice in 3 cups of water, covered, for 18 minutes.
Press the tofu dry, cut it into cubes and toss with the cornstarch.
Fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until golden, then set aside.
Add the broccoli florets and a splash of water to the pan, cover and steam 4 minutes.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, vinegar, sriracha, garlic, ginger and 1/4 cup hot water until smooth.
Return the tofu to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute.
Serve over rice topped with chopped peanuts and green onion.

recipes.name: Pinto Bean Huevos Rancheros
recipes.description: Fried eggs on crisp corn tortillas with mashed pinto beans, warm salsa, cheddar and avocado.
steps: Mash the drained beans in a small pot with the cumin and a splash of water and keep warm.
Warm the salsa in a small saucepan.
Fry the tortillas in a little oil for 30 seconds per side until just crisp.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil to your liking.
Spread beans on each tortilla and top with an egg, salsa, cheddar, avocado and cilantro.

recipes.name: Crunchy Pinto Bean Taco Salad
recipes.description: Romaine piled with seasoned pinto beans, corn, tomato, cheddar, avocado and crushed tortilla chips.
steps: Warm the drained beans with the taco seasoning and a splash of water for 3 minutes.
Stir the salsa, sour cream and lime juice together for the dressing.
Divide the chopped romaine among 4 bowls.
Top with the beans, corn, tomato, cheddar and avocado.
Spoon over the dressing and finish with crushed tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Pork Egg Roll Bowls with Rice
recipes.description: Ground pork stir-fried with coleslaw mix, garlic, ginger and soy sauce, served over white rice.
steps: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the pork for 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook 30 seconds.
Add the coleslaw mix, soy sauce and rice vinegar and stir-fry 4 minutes until the cabbage is just tender.
Stir in the sesame oil and green onions.
Serve over the rice with sriracha on the side.

recipes.name: Pork Egg Roll in a Bowl
recipes.description: Everything inside an egg roll, minus the wrapper: ground pork and cabbage stir-fried with ginger, garlic and soy.
steps: Brown the pork in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up.
Stir in the garlic, ginger and carrot and cook 1 minute.
Add the coleslaw mix, soy sauce and rice vinegar and toss 4 to 5 minutes until just tender.
Drizzle with sesame oil and sriracha.
Top with sliced green onions and serve.

recipes.name: Pork Tenderloin & Sweet Potato Skillet
recipes.description: Strips of smoky pork tenderloin tossed with caramelized sweet potato cubes and red onion.
steps: Cook the sweet potato cubes in half the olive oil, covered, 12 minutes, stirring, until tender and browned.
Slice the pork into thin strips and toss with the smoked paprika, cumin, thyme, salt and pepper.
Move the sweet potatoes to a plate and sear the pork in the remaining oil 5 to 6 minutes.
Add the garlic and half the red onion and cook 1 minute.
Return the sweet potatoes, add the vinegar and toss.
Top with the remaining sliced red onion.

recipes.name: Potato and Pea Curry with Naan
recipes.description: Potatoes and peas simmered in a spiced tomato sauce and scooped up with warm naan.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil over medium heat for 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic, ginger, curry powder, cumin and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, tomatoes, broth and salt.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the peas and cook 3 minutes, mashing a few potatoes to thicken the sauce.
Warm the naan and serve with the curry and cilantro.

recipes.name: Red Beans and Rice with Smoked Sausage
recipes.description: Creamy simmered kidney beans with smoked sausage, onion, bell pepper and celery over white rice.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and brown the sliced sausage for 4 minutes.
Add the onion, bell pepper and celery and cook 6 minutes, then stir in the garlic, smoked paprika, thyme and cayenne.
Add the kidney beans with their liquid, the broth and salt.
Simmer uncovered for 25 minutes, mashing some of the beans against the pot to thicken.
Meanwhile, cook the rice according to the package directions.
Serve the beans over the rice.

recipes.name: Refried Bean and Corn Quesadillas
recipes.description: Crisp flour tortillas filled with refried beans, corn, green chiles and melted cheddar.
steps: Stir the cumin, drained corn and green chiles into the refried beans.
Spread the bean mixture over half of each tortilla, top with cheddar and fold.
Cook in a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until crisp and melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.name: Roast Chicken with Potatoes and Carrots
recipes.description: A whole chicken rubbed with garlic thyme butter and roasted over potatoes, carrots and onion.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the potatoes, carrots and onion with the oil and half the salt in a large roasting pan.
Mash the butter with the garlic, thyme, pepper and remaining salt and rub it all over the chicken.
Put the halved lemon inside the chicken and set it on top of the vegetables.
Roast 70 to 75 minutes until the thigh reaches 165°F.
Rest 10 minutes, then carve and serve with the vegetables and pan juices.

recipes.name: Rotisserie Chicken and Black Bean Quesadillas
recipes.description: Crisp flour tortillas filled with shredded rotisserie chicken, black beans and melted cheddar.
steps: Shred the chicken and toss it with the black beans and cumin.
Sprinkle cheddar over half of each tortilla, add the chicken mixture and fold closed.
Brush a large skillet with a little oil and cook the quesadillas over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.name: Rotisserie Chicken Enchiladas
recipes.description: Flour tortillas rolled around shredded chicken, green chiles and cheddar, baked in red enchilada sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Mix the shredded chicken with the onion, green chiles, cumin, sour cream and half the cheddar.
Spread half a can of enchilada sauce in a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Roll the filling in the tortillas and place them seam-side down in the dish.
Pour over the remaining sauce and top with the remaining cheddar.
Bake 20 minutes until bubbling.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Chickpeas and Vegetables
recipes.description: Chickpeas, sweet potato, broccoli and peppers roasted on one pan and finished with feta and lemon.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the sweet potato, bell pepper, red onion, zucchini and drained chickpeas with the oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, oregano and salt.
Spread over two sheet pans and roast 15 minutes.
Add the broccoli, toss and roast 12 to 15 minutes more until browned.
Squeeze the lemon over the pans and top with feta.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Drumsticks with Potatoes and Carrots
recipes.description: Paprika-rubbed chicken drumsticks roasted on one pan with crispy potatoes and sweet carrots.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the potatoes and carrots with half the oil and half the salt on a large sheet pan.
Rub the drumsticks with the remaining oil, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, pepper and remaining salt.
Nestle the drumsticks among the vegetables.
Roast 35 to 40 minutes, turning once, until the chicken reaches 175°F and the potatoes are golden.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Lemon Salmon & Broccoli
recipes.description: Salmon fillets and broccoli roasted together on one pan with garlic, butter and lemon.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the broccoli florets with the olive oil, garlic, salt and pepper on a sheet pan and roast 8 minutes.
Add the salmon to the pan, dot with butter and top with lemon slices.
Roast 10 to 12 minutes until the salmon flakes easily.
Squeeze the remaining lemon over everything.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Paprika Drumsticks & Potatoes
recipes.description: Budget drumsticks and potato wedges roasted together in a smoky paprika and garlic rub until crisp.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Cut the potatoes into wedges.
Toss the drumsticks and potatoes with the olive oil, both paprikas, garlic powder, onion powder, salt and pepper.
Spread on a sheet pan and roast 40 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is crisp and cooked through.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Pork Tenderloin with Sweet Potatoes
recipes.description: Honey-mustard pork tenderloin roasted on one pan with sweet potatoes and green beans.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the sweet potatoes with half the oil and half the salt on a sheet pan and roast 10 minutes.
Rub the pork with the mustard, honey, garlic powder, smoked paprika, pepper and remaining salt.
Toss the green beans with the remaining oil, then add the pork and beans to the pan.
Roast 20 minutes until the pork reaches 145°F.
Rest the pork 5 minutes, slice and serve with the vegetables.

recipes.name: Skillet Pork Chops with Green Beans and Potatoes
recipes.description: Pan-seared seasoned pork chops with garlic butter green beans and tender baby potatoes.
steps: Boil the halved potatoes in salted water for 12 to 15 minutes until tender, adding the green beans for the last 4 minutes, then drain.
Season the pork chops with the paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chops 4 to 5 minutes per side until they reach 145°F.
Rest the chops on a plate and melt the butter with the garlic in the same pan.
Toss the potatoes and green beans in the garlic butter and serve with the chops.

recipes.name: Skillet Shakshuka with Feta
recipes.description: Eggs poached in a smoky tomato and pepper sauce, finished with crumbled feta.
steps: Cook the onion and bell pepper in the oil in a large skillet over medium heat for 6 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, tomato paste, cumin, smoked paprika and pepper flakes for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer 8 minutes until slightly thickened.
Make 8 wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook 5 to 7 minutes until the whites are set.
Top with feta and cilantro.

recipes.name: Sloppy Joes with Quick Coleslaw
recipes.description: Saucy sweet-and-tangy ground beef piled on toasted buns with a fast creamy coleslaw.
steps: Toss the coleslaw mix with the mayonnaise, vinegar and salt and chill while you cook.
Brown the ground beef with the onion and bell pepper in a large skillet for 7 minutes, then drain the fat.
Stir in the tomato sauce, ketchup, brown sugar, Worcestershire and mustard.
Simmer 6 to 8 minutes until thick.
Toast the buns, fill them with the beef and serve with the coleslaw.

recipes.name: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork Sandwiches
recipes.description: Pork shoulder slow-cooked until it shreds, tossed in BBQ sauce and piled on buns with creamy coleslaw.
steps: Rub the pork with the brown sugar, smoked paprika, garlic powder and most of the salt.
Put the sliced onion in the slow cooker, set the pork on top and add half the vinegar and 1/2 cup water.
Cook on low for 7 hours until the pork falls apart.
Shred the pork with two forks, drain off most of the liquid and stir in the BBQ sauce.
Toss the coleslaw mix with the mayonnaise, remaining vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Pile the pork and coleslaw onto the buns.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Pulled Pork Slaw Bowls
recipes.description: Spice-rubbed pork shoulder cooked low and slow, shredded and piled over tangy slaw and spinach.
steps: Rub the pork with the smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, salt and pepper.
Place in a slow cooker with the broth and 1 tablespoon of the vinegar and cook on low 8 hours.
Shred the pork with two forks and moisten with the cooking juices.
Toss the coleslaw mix with the mayo, mustard and remaining vinegar.
Divide the spinach and slaw among bowls and top with the pork.

recipes.name: Smoked Sausage, Cabbage and Potato Skillet
recipes.description: Browned smoked sausage fried with tender cabbage, diced potatoes and onion in one skillet.
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the sliced sausage for 4 minutes, then set it aside.
Add the butter and potatoes, cover and cook 8 minutes, stirring once or twice.
Add the onion, cabbage, garlic, salt and pepper and cook 8 minutes until the cabbage is tender and the potatoes are golden.
Return the sausage to the pan and stir in the mustard and vinegar.
Cook 1 more minute and serve.

recipes.name: Smoked Sausage, Pepper & Cabbage Skillet
recipes.description: Sliced smoked sausage fried with cabbage, onion and green pepper for a cheap, filling one-pan dinner.
steps: Slice the sausage into coins and brown in a large skillet 4 to 5 minutes.
Add the butter, onion and bell pepper and cook 3 minutes.
Add the cabbage, garlic, smoked paprika and pepper.
Cook 8 to 10 minutes, stirring, until the cabbage is tender and browned at the edges.
Stir in the vinegar and serve.

recipes.name: Southwest Quinoa and Black Bean Salad
recipes.description: Quinoa tossed with black beans, corn, peppers and avocado in a cumin lime dressing.
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer it in 2 cups of water, covered, for 15 minutes, then spread on a plate to cool.
Whisk the lime juice, oil, cumin, chili powder and salt in a large bowl.
Add the drained beans and corn, bell pepper, tomato and green onion.
Fold in the quinoa and cilantro.
Top with avocado just before serving.

recipes.name: Spinach and Feta Oven Frittata
recipes.description: A thick baked egg frittata packed with spinach, cottage cheese, feta and cheddar.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Cook the onion in the butter and oil in a 12-inch oven-safe skillet for 4 minutes, then add the garlic and spinach and stir until wilted.
Whisk the eggs with the cottage cheese, cheddar, salt and pepper.
Pour the eggs over the spinach, stir once and scatter the feta on top.
Cook 2 minutes on the stove, then bake 14 to 16 minutes until set and puffed.
Rest 5 minutes and cut into wedges.

recipes.name: Three-Bean Vegetarian Chili
recipes.description: A thick meatless chili with black, kidney and pinto beans, corn and peppers, topped with cheddar.
steps: Cook the onion and bell pepper in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, chili powder, cumin and smoked paprika for 1 minute.
Add the crushed and diced tomatoes, the drained beans, broth and salt.
Simmer partly covered for 30 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the corn and cook 5 minutes more.
Serve topped with cheddar.

recipes.name: Tofu Egg Roll in a Bowl
recipes.description: Crumbled tofu, cabbage and scrambled egg stir-fried with ginger, garlic and soy sauce.
steps: Press the tofu dry and crumble it into bite-size pieces.
Brown the tofu in the vegetable oil over high heat for 6 minutes, then push it to one side.
Scramble the eggs in the empty side of the pan and break them up.
Add the garlic, ginger and coleslaw mix and stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes until the cabbage just wilts.
Stir in the soy sauce, vinegar and sesame oil.
Serve topped with green onion and a drizzle of sriracha.

recipes.name: Tofu Scramble Black Bean Burritos
recipes.description: Spiced scrambled tofu, black beans, peppers and cheddar rolled into warm flour tortillas.
steps: Drain the tofu, pat it dry and crumble it with your hands.
Cook the onion and bell pepper in the oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes.
Add the tofu, cumin, chili powder, turmeric and salt and cook 6 minutes, stirring, until dry and lightly browned.
Stir in the drained beans and heat through.
Warm the tortillas, fill with the scramble, cheddar and salsa, and roll up.

recipes.name: Tuna Noodle Casserole with Peas
recipes.description: Egg noodles, canned tuna and peas in a creamy cheddar sauce, baked with a crunchy breadcrumb top.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and boil the egg noodles 2 minutes less than the package says, then drain.
Melt the butter in a large pot and cook the onion for 4 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thick.
Stir in the cheddar, salt and pepper, then fold in the noodles, drained tuna and peas.
Spread in a 2-quart baking dish and top with the breadcrumbs.
Bake 18 minutes until bubbling and golden.

recipes.name: Turkey and Spinach Lasagna
recipes.description: Layers of noodles, ground turkey marinara, spinach, cottage cheese and melted mozzarella.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and boil the lasagna noodles until just pliable, then drain.
Brown the turkey with the garlic and Italian seasoning for 6 minutes, then stir in the marinara.
Mix the cottage cheese with the egg, parmesan, salt and the thawed, squeezed-dry spinach.
Layer sauce, noodles, cottage cheese mixture and mozzarella in a 9-inch square baking dish, three times, ending with mozzarella.
Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes, then uncover and bake 15 minutes more.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Turkey Bolognese Zucchini Noodles
recipes.description: A hearty ground turkey and tomato sauce spooned over tender zucchini noodles with plenty of parmesan.
steps: Cut the zucchini into long thin noodles with a spiralizer or vegetable peeler.
Brown the turkey in the olive oil with the garlic.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, Italian seasoning and salt and simmer 12 minutes.
Saute the zucchini noodles in a second pan 2 to 3 minutes until just tender.
Top the noodles with the sauce and parmesan.

recipes.name: Turkey Taco Salad Bowls
recipes.description: Taco-seasoned ground turkey over crisp romaine with tomato, cheddar, avocado, salsa and sour cream; no chips needed.
steps: Brown the turkey in a skillet, breaking it up, 7 to 8 minutes.
Stir in the taco seasoning and a splash of water and simmer 2 minutes.
Chop the romaine and divide among 4 bowls.
Top with the turkey, tomato, cheddar and avocado.
Finish with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.name: Turkey & Two-Bean Chili
recipes.description: A big pot of ground turkey chili with kidney and black beans, peppers and tomatoes; better the next day.
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion and bell pepper in the olive oil.
Stir in the garlic, chili powder, cumin and salt and cook 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, broth and drained beans.
Simmer 25 minutes, stirring now and then.
Taste, adjust the seasoning and serve.

recipes.name: Two-Bean Minestrone Soup
recipes.description: A big pot of vegetable soup with cabbage, zucchini, beans and elbow pasta in tomato broth.
steps: Cook the onion, carrot and celery in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic and Italian seasoning for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth, cabbage, zucchini and salt and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the drained beans and the pasta and cook 8 to 10 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Thin with a little water if needed and serve with parmesan.

recipes.name: Unstuffed Cabbage Roll Skillet
recipes.description: All the flavor of cabbage rolls without the rolling: ground beef and chopped cabbage simmered in tomato sauce.
steps: Brown the beef with the onion in the olive oil, then stir in the garlic and paprika.
Add the chopped cabbage, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, broth, salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the cabbage is tender.
Taste, adjust the seasoning and serve in bowls.

recipes.name: Vegetable Egg Fried Rice
recipes.description: Rice stir-fried with scrambled eggs, frozen mixed vegetables, garlic and soy sauce.
steps: Cook the rice in 2 3/4 cups of water, covered, for 16 minutes, then spread it on a tray to steam dry (or use leftover rice).
Scramble the eggs in half the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok and set aside.
Stir-fry the frozen vegetables and garlic in the remaining oil over high heat for 3 minutes.
Add the rice and fry 4 minutes, pressing out any clumps.
Stir in the eggs, soy sauce, sesame oil and green onion and serve.

recipes.name: Veggie Ramen Stir-Fry with Eggs
recipes.description: Ramen noodles tossed with stir-fry vegetables, scrambled eggs and a garlic soy sauce.
steps: Boil the ramen noodles for 2 minutes (leave out the seasoning packets) and drain.
Scramble the eggs in half the vegetable oil in a large skillet and set aside.
Stir-fry the frozen vegetables, garlic and ginger in the remaining oil over high heat for 5 minutes.
Mix the soy sauce, brown sugar, sriracha and sesame oil.
Add the noodles, eggs and sauce to the pan and toss 1 to 2 minutes.
Top with green onion.

recipes.name: Weeknight Chicken Tikka Masala with Rice
recipes.description: Chicken simmered in a creamy spiced tomato sauce from pantry staples, served over white rice.
steps: Simmer the rice with 3 cups water, covered, 18 minutes.
Toss the diced chicken with the yogurt, half the curry powder and the salt.
Brown the chicken in the butter 6 minutes, then add the onion, garlic and ginger and cook 3 minutes.
Stir in the remaining curry powder, cumin, paprika, tomato sauce and tomato paste and simmer 12 minutes.
Stir in the cream and heat through.
Serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Weeknight Spaghetti with Meat Sauce
recipes.description: Spaghetti tossed in a quick ground beef and marinara sauce with onion, garlic and parmesan.
steps: Boil the spaghetti in salted water until al dente, then drain.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large skillet and cook the onion for 4 minutes.
Add the ground beef and garlic and brown for 6 to 8 minutes, then drain the fat.
Stir in the marinara and Italian seasoning and simmer 8 minutes.
Toss the spaghetti with the sauce and top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Zucchini and Cottage Cheese Lasagna
recipes.description: Roasted zucchini planks stand in for noodles, layered with cottage cheese, marinara and mozzarella.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F, slice the zucchini lengthwise into 1/4-inch planks, salt them and roast on two sheet pans for 12 minutes.
Blot the zucchini dry with paper towels and lower the oven to 375°F.
Mix the cottage cheese with the egg, garlic, Italian seasoning, half the parmesan and half the mozzarella.
Layer a little marinara, zucchini, cottage cheese mixture and more marinara in an 8x8 dish, repeating twice.
Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake 30 minutes until browned, then rest 10 minutes before slicing.
